titles.romaji: Peeping Life: Shinkon-chan Kansai ni Irasshai
titles.native: Peeping Life 『新婚ちゃん関西にいらっしゃい』

description:
The newlyweds have moved to the Kansai region! For now they've settled down, but their room is still a huge mess. They also realize that they've been wasting a lot of electricity, and they begin to ponder ways to cut back on their bills.

(Source: Anime Bancho)
